title: TracePath Open Digital Product Passport Schema - Footwear & Leather Goods
description: Machine-readable starter DPP schema for footwear and leather goods, designed for experimentation under the EU ESPR framework.

dpp_id.description: Cryptographic unique identifier for the published DPP.

gtin.description: GS1 GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14 barcode identifier.

tannery_certification.description: LWG (Leather Working Group) or equivalent rating

repairability_index.description: Illustrative TracePath field for pilot use; not an official EU repairability scale.

snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic snapshot hash of immutable passport data.
